summary: Dry, grey Saturday with a cold, misty start: 2–4 °C and humidity near 100% on the A-2 at Medinaceli and about 1 °C at dawn around Daroca, so fog patches or light frost are possible on the outbound drive until about 11:00. No closures, roadworks, strikes or events found that affect the A-2 or N-234 today.

items.title: Mist, fog or frost patches possible before 11:00
items.detail: Medinaceli 3–4 °C with mist and humidity near 100% around 09:00–10:00, Daroca about 1 °C at dawn; AEMET has no warning for Soria. Use dipped lights, keep speed down in fog and take shaded bridges gently; it should lift by late morning.

items.title: Bus-VAO lane on the A-2 toward Madrid
items.detail: The A-2 has a Bus-VAO (high-occupancy) lane between Alcalá and Madrid. Check the overhead signs for who may use it before moving into it on the way back to the airport.

weather.wind: NE 8 km/h, gusts up to 16 km/h

weather.sky: mist early, then overcast, high cloud from 13:00
weather.wind: NW 11–14 km/h, gusts up to 23 km/h
